description: Default capability for the main window and every pop-out. A window missing from this list gets no Tauri APIs at all: it loads, and then nothing in it works, silently. allow-destroy rides with allow-close: once the frontend listens for the close request (app.tsx flushes the autosave first), Tauri hands the actual closing to the frontend, and that is a destroy call. Without it the close button and File > Exit did nothing.
